extensionDescription.message: Gmail-like search expressions for Thunderbird's quick filter bar: type "from:fred to:tom a:yes" to see all messages from Fred to Tom with an attachment. Regular expressions, click-to-search, saved searches. Open-source continuation of Expression Search / GMailUI.

searchBoxPlaceholderWithKey.description: $1 is the keyboard shortcut, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+K

helpBlank.message: Type keywords or operators such as from:, to:, subject:, body:, a:yes. Enter: search now · Ctrl+Enter: saved search · Shift+Enter: global search.

helpNormalFilter.message: No operators: acting like the normal quick filter (see the field buttons below).

helpCalc.message: Calculator: press Enter to show the result.

helpBodyStats.message: Body searched in $1 of $2 messages; the others have no offline copy (enable offline sync to search them).

helpNoResultsGloda.message: No matches here. Press Shift+Enter to search all folders (global search).

savedSearchUnavailable.message: A saved search can only be created for a valid expression while a folder is displayed.

savedSearchBadParent.message: The folder configured for saved searches does not exist any more. Please check the options.

savedSearchNameTaken.message: A folder named "$1" that is not a saved search is in the way.

savedSearchNotExact.message: Saved searches cannot store parentheses: with more than one OR group this saved search may show more messages than the message list.

glodaDisabled.message: Global search is disabled (Settings › General › Global Search and Indexer).

info_after.message:
after:2011/03/10   af:(2011/03/01 -2011/03/09)   after:Mon, 25 Dec 1995 13:30:00 GMT
af:(3:00 -4:00) finds messages sent between 3 and 4 o'clock on any day

info_all.message: Searches From, To, Cc, Subject and the body

info_attachment.message: a:yes or a:no; any other value searches attachment names/types (like filename:)

info_bcc.message: Bcc field contains (only known for messages you sent)

info_bodyre.message: bodyre:/hello.*world/i — body matches a regular expression; must be the last operator. Slow on large folders.

info_date.message: date:2011/01 or date:2011/01/03 — date (yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm:ss) contains

info_days.message: older_than:3 / age:2w / days:today — older than N days; units: d, w, m, y; today and yesterday

info_filename.message: filename:report.pdf   fi:image   fn:msword — attachment name or type contains

info_from.message: from:(Alice or Bob) — From field contains

info_fromre.message: fromre:/^[a-d].*$/i — From matches a regular expression (last operator)

info_fromto.message: fromto:alice — From, To, Cc or Bcc contains

info_gloda.message: g: at the start runs a global (gloda) search over all indexed folders

info_headerre.message: headerre:List-Id=/all-test/i   h:list-id — header present / matches; the header must be listed in the options (customDBHeaders)

info_newer_than.message: newer_than:8   n:7w   nt:1y — newer than N days

info_only.message: only:tom — tom is the only recipient in the To field

info_regex.message: regex:/^begin/i   re:end$ — subject matches a regular expression (last operator)

info_simple.message: simple:hello (world) — subject contains the rest of the input literally (last operator)

info_size.message: size:10 or larger:1.4M — size in KB (K, M, G suffixes) greater than

info_smaller.message: smaller:1G or sm:1024 — size less than

info_status.message: is:replied, is:unread, is:starred, status:forwarded — Read, Unread, Replied, Starred/Flagged, Forwarded, New, Deleted, Attachment

info_subject.message: subject:(hello -world) — subject contains hello but not world

info_tag.message: tag:important or tag:#2 — tag name contains; tag:na means no tag

info_tore.message: tore:/^[a-d].*$/i — To/Cc/Bcc match a regular expression (last operator)

error_tooComplex.message: The expression is too complex to search (too many OR combinations).

opt_hideNormalFilter.message: Hide the normal quick filter text box (Ctrl+Shift+K then focuses Expression Search)

opt_actAsNormalFilter.message: Act like the normal quick filter when the input contains no operators

opt_searchTimeout.message: Start searching after you stop typing for

opt_searchTimeoutHint.message: 0 = only search when Enter is pressed

opt_selectFirstOnEnter.message: Select the first message after pressing Enter

opt_showHelp.message: Show the help popup while typing (it closes on Enter, when you leave the box or select a message)

opt_helpShowSeconds.message: Also close it when you stop typing for

opt_virtualFolderParent.message: Create or update the "ExpressionSearch" saved search folder in

opt_virtualFolderParentDefault.message: The account of the current folder

opt_reuseExistingFolder.message: Keep the folders selected for an existing saved search (only update the search terms)

opt_virtualFolderInNewTab.message: Open the saved search in a new tab

opt_c2sIntro.message: Hold a modifier key and right-click a subject, sender, recipient, tag or date in the message list to search for it. The message list context menu also has an "Expression Search" submenu.

opt_c2sCtrlReplace.message: Apply the subject replacement below for Ctrl + right-click

opt_c2sShiftReplace.message: Apply the subject replacement below for Shift + right-click

opt_c2sReplaceHint.message: Example: match "Bug (\d+)" replace "Bug $1". Several matches are combined with "or".

opt_c2sRemoveDomain.message: Remove the domain from e-mail addresses (search for "fred" instead of "fred@example.com")

opt_customDBHeaders.message: Extra headers stored in the message database, separated by spaces

opt_customDBHeadersHint.message: Thunderbird only stores these headers for messages downloaded after the change; repair a folder (Folder Properties › Repair Folder) to include existing messages. This is a Thunderbird-wide setting.

opt_verbose.message: Log searches to the Error Console (Ctrl+Shift+J)

invalidHeaders.message: Use header names (letters, digits and "-") separated by spaces
